name: @semicoder/fia
description: Command-line tools for building FIA macOS applications

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/config.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/config.js && bun build src/runtime.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/runtime.js && bun build src/native.ts --target=browser --outfile=dist/native.js && bun build src/backend.ts --target=browser --outfile=dist/backend.js && bun build src/runtime/managed.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/managed-runtime.js && bun ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test tests
